Class TransformSequence<T>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A sequence of osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms all operating upon the same osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.ITransformable of type T. Exposes various operations to extend the sequence by additional osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms such as delays, loops, continuations, and events.

public class TransformSequence<T> : ITransformSequence where T : class, ITransformable

Type Parameters

T

The type of the osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.ITransformable the osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms in this sequence operate upon.

Finally(Action<T>)

Registers a callback function which is triggered once any osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transform in this osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.TransformSequence`1 is aborted or when all osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms complete successfully. This is equivalent with calling both osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.TransformSequence`1.OnComplete(System.Action{`0}) and osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.TransformSequence`1.OnAbort(System.Action{`0}). Only a single callback function may be registered.
